timing_method: No warm-up runs. Outer execution_time_seconds uses perf_counter around each algorithm invocation, including selection/orchestration overhead but excluding scenario generation and file I/O. Stage CSV times are solver-reported times.
dataset_split: Largest-remainder proportional test allocation by parameter stratum; seeded permutation breaks equal-remainder ties and selects members within strata

split_coverage.limitation: Full-combination coverage is only claimed when every combination is present in the split; small scenario counts may cover only a subset. Factor coverage is reported independently.

synthetic_model_note: Satellite directions are synthetic local ENU rays, not orbital ephemerides
